observations: Two car headlight assemblies are shown side by side on a tiled floor.
The headlights have a modern, angular design with clear lenses and internal reflectors.
The top headlight has a circular projector lens and a smaller rectangular LED section.
The bottom headlight has a similar design but with a different internal configuration, including a larger rectangular section.
Both units have black plastic housings and mounting brackets.
There is a watermark 'POSTED ON PUREGOLD GLOBAL' across the image.
No visible branding or model identifiers are readable on the headlights themselves.
The condition appears clean and undamaged from the outside.

claims.claim: All Mazda genuine spare parts and accessories are available both new and fairly used ones.
claims.evidence: No visible branding or model identifiers on the headlights to confirm they are Mazda or genuine. The watermark 'PUREGOLD GLOBAL' suggests a reseller, not a manufacturer.

risks.risk: The headlights may not be genuine Mazda parts, or may be from a different brand or model.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the headlight housing showing any brand name, model number, or part number, or a photo of the part number on the back or side.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic or non-genuine parts, which reduces value significantly.

risks.risk: The headlights may be damaged internally or have electrical issues not visible from the outside.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the headlights being tested for functionality, including turning on the main beam and auxiliary lights.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The headlights may be used or refurbished, not 'fairly used' as claimed.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the interior of the housing or the back of the unit showing signs of wear, scratches, or previous repairs.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the headlight housing showing any brand or model markings.
Photo of the part number or serial number on the back or side of the unit.
Video or photo showing the headlights being tested for functionality.
Close-up of the interior of the housing or back of the unit to check for wear or damage.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
